Review Partnero?

Reviewers mostly describe Partnero as polished, easy to set up, and strong on customization, with useful documentation, a clean portal, and simple management of multiple partner programs in one dashboard. One user also says migration was smooth with hands-on help from the team. But the negative reviews are pointed: they report slow, ineffective support during integration, unresolved tracking problems around sales and commission rates, and even site blocking issues. A maker of Ycode specifically says they use it to manage their affiliate program.
